color: rgb(254, 226, 226) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
TAP IT FIRST
Gram stain,
culture, crystals
Empiric antibiotics
Crystals do NOT
exclude infection

div.style: color: rgb(224, 231, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Choose by
COMORBIDITY,
not by preference

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
NSAID
naproxen
500 mg BID
AVOID: eGFR <30,
PUD, HF,
anticoagulation

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
COLCHICINE
1.2 mg, then
0.6 mg at 1 h
AVOID: strong
CYP3A4 / P-gp
clarithromycin
= FATAL

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
GLUCOCORTICOID
prednisolone
30-35 mg
x 3-5 days
Safe in CKD
Watch glucose

div.style: color: rgb(209, 250, 229) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
INTRA-ARTICULAR
triamcinolone
~40 mg
1-2 joints
only after tap
excludes sepsis

div.style: color: rgb(224, 231, 255) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;
color: rgb(219, 228, 240) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
Continue until
fully resolved,
then 2-3 days.
DO NOT stop
existing ULT.

div.style: color: rgb(254, 243, 199) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
SWITCH class, or
COMBINE 2 agents
NEVER NSAID +
systemic steroid

div.style: color: rgb(254, 226, 226) !important; display: table-cell; white-space: nowrap; line-height: 1.5; max-width: 200px; text-align: center;

span.p:
REFRACTORY /
all contraindicated
IL-1 BLOCKADE
anakinra 100 mg SC
daily x 3-5 d
or canakinumab
150 mg SC x 1
